## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1458 invitations were sent to people in the River Districts. Attendance totalled 156, representing a rate of 10.7 per cent. The figures indicate that a proportion of those invited took part, while many invitees did not attend. The outreach team will continue to monitor responses and attendance so that future contact can be managed consistently. Records of invitations and attendance will support this ongoing work.

## Contact

SMS was used for 1243 invitations. No reminder message was recorded, with 0 people receiving a reminder. Staff continue to contact people who missed appointments, using the available outreach information to support further engagement. The contact activity and attendance figures provide a clear record of the response during the reporting period and will inform continuing follow-up. Any further contact should be recorded alongside the existing invitation and attendance information to maintain an accurate account of outreach activity.
